# Studio screenshots

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/capture from scripts/capture/assets.json. Do not edit; run `pnpm capture`. -->

ReelForge Studio is a server without a graphical interface: you drive it from a terminal, from an AI agent over MCP, or over REST. These views are real sessions against a studio started from the repository, captured by `pnpm capture --only studio` on 2026-11-22 and drawn as terminal pages. API keys and tokens are masked; the commands show `$REELFORGE_KEY` where the key goes.

## Terminal sessions

### Create an API key

The key is printed once; it is masked here. `keys list` never shows it again.

![Create an API key](https://storage.googleapis.com/buildbase/orgs/6b01478bb42d2c444e99fcd8-fsyqdskf/assets/file-1795338787791-891292814.webp)

### Start the studio

Database migrations, plugin registry and the REST and MCP endpoints on 127.0.0.1.

![Start the studio](https://storage.googleapis.com/buildbase/orgs/6b01478bb42d2c444e99fcd8-fsyqdskf/assets/file-1795338790350-639294347.webp)

### Connect Claude Code over MCP

`claude mcp list` connects to the studio to check it: "Connected" means the key and the /mcp endpoint work.

![Connect Claude Code over MCP](https://storage.googleapis.com/buildbase/orgs/6b01478bb42d2c444e99fcd8-fsyqdskf/assets/file-1795338787204-137484575.webp)

### Readiness

A load balancer or Docker health check reads the short answer; an admin key gets every check.

![Readiness: /readyz](https://storage.googleapis.com/buildbase/orgs/6b01478bb42d2c444e99fcd8-fsyqdskf/assets/file-1795338788953-197634398.webp)

### Prometheus metrics

Served when observability.metrics.exporter is prometheus, to callers with the bearer token (REELFORGE_METRICS_TOKEN, masked).

![Prometheus metrics: /metrics](https://storage.googleapis.com/buildbase/orgs/6b01478bb42d2c444e99fcd8-fsyqdskf/assets/file-1795338788292-862664667.webp)

### A render job and its progress

POST /v1/projects, validate, render, then GET /v1/jobs/{id}?wait= (long-poll) until it succeeds: every scene is rendered by its engine, then assembled and checked.

![A render job and its progress](https://storage.googleapis.com/buildbase/orgs/6b01478bb42d2c444e99fcd8-fsyqdskf/assets/file-1795338789611-153372530.webp)

## An agent makes a reel

The last frame of the replay of a recorded Claude Code session: prompt, tool calls and results on the left, the reel it rendered on the right. The whole session is a [walkthrough video](/docs/screenshots/walkthroughs).

![Agent session over MCP (last frame of the replay)](https://storage.googleapis.com/buildbase/orgs/6b01478bb42d2c444e99fcd8-fsyqdskf/assets/file-1795338786594-136319743.webp)

## Contact sheets of the built-in templates
